messages:
Ivy Park: Quick design thread — deciding copy & focus behaviour for stacktrace rows in Request Drilldown. Two options: inline copy pill vs row-level overflow. Mock: https://figma.com/file/stack-copy-mocks Marcus Li: Inline pill is faster for single-frame share. Overflow keeps UI cleaner when many frames show. Heather Zhou: Prefer inline pill but only show on hover or when row is focused to reduce clutter. Samir Kaur: Accessibility: if the pill appears on hover it must still be keyboard reachable. Make it part of tab order when revealed. a11y-bot: Contrast check: pill bg #f2f2f2 on white is low. Ensure >=3:1 for interactive elements. Also provide aria-live confirmations for copy actions. Ivy Park: Copy interaction idea: Space/Enter on the pill to copy frame text; Enter on the row opens mini menu with more actions (Copy frame, Copy link, Export JSON). Marcus Li: That keeps keyboard semantics consistent: row = navigation/menu, pill = direct action. Also show a transient check icon next to pill for 1s on success. Heather Zhou: Microcopy: menu verbs: "Copy frame", "Copy permalink", "Export trace (JSON)". Tooltip for pill: "Copy frame (press Enter)". Samir Kaur: For screen reader flow, on copy update hidden live region: "Frame 5 copied to clipboard." Include frame number and function name. Example: aria-live region "Frame handleRequest (line 124) copied." a11y-bot: ARIA snippet recommendation:
and ensure focus remains predictable after copy. Ivy Park: Permalink behavior: should click=copy or open? Proposal: primary click on permalink icon = copy, overflow has "Open in new tab". Document shift-click to open directly. Marcus Li: Agree. If copy fails (clipboard API missing) open a small dialog with the URL selected for manual copy. Heather Zhou: Export UX: default "Export frames (CSV)" from table view, and "Export trace (JSON)" from trace detail. Modal should note: "Exports respect current filters". Samir Kaur: Keyboard shortcut caution: avoid global single-letter shortcuts. Prefer mnemonic combos documented in keyboard help. Ivy Park: Next steps: I'll update Figma with hover-reveal pill + focus rules. @Samir draft aria messages and focus management. @Marcus prototype success check animation. @Heather update microcopy and tooltip text. Will post updated mock by EOD. :thumbsup:
